titleFront: More Systems Will Rally To Our Cause

flipToBack.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToBack.prose: Flips when two [Separatist] systems can be spotted on table. Pure card-on-table count; no control/occupy requirement and no ownership restriction in the filter.

flipToFront.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToFront.prose: Flips back when FEWER than two [Separatist] systems are on table (negation of the same canSpot count-2 check).

requirementSemantics: Flip both ways is CARD-ON-TABLE COUNT semantics: canSpot(game, self, 2, Filters.and(Icon.SEPARATIST, Filters.system)). No control, no occupy, no ownership filter - any two spottable [Separatist] systems (converted opponent locations included if spottable) hold the back side.

Back's Force-loss engine is OCCUPY semantics with a related-site conjunction: countTopLocationsOnTable(Filters.and(Filters.system, Filters.occupies(playerId), Filters.relatedSystemTo(self, Filters.and(Filters.site, Filters.occupies(playerId))))) - X = systems you occupy whose related site you also occupy.

Back's drain -1 and Separatist-starship attrition immunity are location-relational: Filters.relatedSystemTo(self, Filters.and(Filters.site, Filters.occupies(self.getOwner()))) - systems related to sites you occupy.
Both sides share the once-per-turn related-battleground-site download via GameTextActionId.MORE_AND_MORE_SYSTEMS_ARE_JOINING_THE_SEPARATISTS__DEPLOY_BATTLEGROUND_SITE.
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.not(Icon.EPISODE_I), Filters.or(Filters.character, Filters.starship, Filters.vehicle)) (may not deploy, both sides)
Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.or(Icon.SEPARATIST, Icon.CLONE_ARMY), Filters.system) (download anchor systems)
Filters.or(Filters.title("Separatist Command Center"), Filters.and(Filters.site, <union of Filters.relatedLocationEvenWhenNotInPlay(system)>)) constrained to Filters.battleground (download target)
Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Icon.SEPARATIST, Filters.starship, Filters.at(Filters.relatedSystemTo(self, Filters.and(Filters.site, Filters.occupies(self.getOwner()))))) (immune to attrition)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys [Separatist] Geonosis system, TWO [Clone Army] systems (two separate required effects with the same filter), and Droid Racks from Reserve Deck (front:50-81).

Shared pull (both sides, same action id): once per turn, deploy from Reserve Deck a battleground site related to your [Separatist] or [Clone Army] system, or Separatist Command Center by title; reshuffle (front:92-121; BACK:61-92).
otherObligations: Both sides, coded as while-active modifier on each: you may not deploy non-[Episode I] characters, starships, or vehicles (front:84-89; BACK:54).

Both sides: if your [Episode I] system was just converted, raise it (the new location) to the top (ConvertLocationByRaisingToTopEffect; front:146-161; BACK:159-179). NOTE: the back's copy contains leftover System.out.println debug lines and dereferences oldLocation.getTitle() before the null check (BACK:163-168) - potential NPE defect, recorded as observed.

Back: during your control phase, opponent loses X Force where X = number of systems you occupy where you also occupy a related site (top-level action BACK:94-111, plus required end-of-control-phase enforcement BACK:140-157).
Back: opponent's Force drains -1 at systems related to sites you occupy (BACK:55).
Back: your [Separatist] starships at such systems are immune to attrition (BACK:56).

Strategic note from law: the back is held ONLY by keeping two [Separatist] systems on table - protect them from conversion/blow-away; the occupy-system-plus-related-site pattern is the scoring engine, not the flip law.

profileGaps: No profile exists in objective_playbooks.json for frontBp 501_19 (playtesting set 501 card; also absent from both seed facts files).

If a profile is created: flip gate is a card-on-table COUNT (two Icon.SEPARATIST systems), flip-back is its negation; setup requires THREE system deploys plus Droid Racks; the shared related-battleground-site download and the back's occupy-system+related-site Force-loss engine are the strategic drivers.
